description.zh: 指定新建主机账户的名称，最长支持128字符。
description.en: The name of the new host account. The name can be up to 128 characters long.

description.zh:
指定要创建主机账户的主机ID。

> 可通过调用[ListHosts](~~200665~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the host for which you want to create a host account.

> Call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to obtain the host ID.
The ID of the shared key for the host.

description.zh:
指定要创建主机账户的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。
> 可通过调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取堡垒机实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance where you want to create the host account.

> Call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.

description.zh:
定新建主机账户的私钥口令。

> 主机账户协议ProtocolName为SSH时，您可以配置该参数。ProtocolName为RDP时，无需配置该参数。
description.en:
The passphrase for the private key of the new host account.

> You can set this parameter only when ProtocolName is set to SSH. You do not need to set this parameter if ProtocolName is set to RDP.

description.zh: 指定新建主机账户的密码。
description.en: The password of the new host account.

description.zh:
指定新建主机账户的私钥，即使用Base64编码后的字符串。

> 主机账户协议ProtocolName为SSH时，该参数生效。ProtocolName为RDP时，无需配置该参数。支持同时为主机账户配置密码和私钥。在连接资产时，堡垒机会优先使用私钥进行连接。
description.en:
The private key of the new host account. The value is a Base64-encoded string.

> This parameter is used only when ProtocolName is set to SSH. You do not need to set this parameter if ProtocolName is set to RDP. You can set both a password and a private key for the host account. When connecting to the asset, Bastionhost prioritizes the private key for the connection.

description.zh:
账户权限类型，不填时默认为Normal
- **Privileged**：特权账户
- **Normal**：普通账户
>仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用。
description.en:
The permission type of the account. If you do not set this parameter, the default value is Normal.

- **Privileged**: privileged account

- **Normal**: normal account

> This parameter is supported only in Bastionhost V3.2.47 and later.

description.zh:
指定新建主机账户的协议名称。
取值： - SSH - RDP
description.en:
The protocol of the new host account.
Valid values:
- SSH - RDP

description.zh:
指定要创建主机账户的主机所在堡垒机的地域ID。

> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where you want to create the host account.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
账户改密模式，不填时默认为Self
- **Privileged**：使用特权账户改密
- **Self**：不使用特权账户改密
>仅支持V3.2.47及以上的版本使用。
description.en:
The password change mode for the account. If you do not set this parameter, the default value is Self.

- **Privileged**: Use a privileged account to change the password.

- **Self**: Do not use a privileged account to change the password.

> This parameter is supported only in Bastionhost V3.2.47 and later.

title.zh: 为指定主机创建主机账户

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-host-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --protocol-name SSH --host-account-name accountname --password 123456 --biz-private-key LS0tLS1000000RCBSU0tLQ== --pass-phrase 123456 --host-share-key-id 1 --privilege-type Normal --rotation-mode Self --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost CreateHostAccount --region cn-hangzhou --ProtocolName SSH --HostAccountName accountname --PrivateKey 'LS0tLS1000000RCBSU0tLQ==' --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --RotationMode Self --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostId 1 --PassPhrase 123456 --HostShareKeyId 1 --PrivilegeType Normal --Password 123456
